messages.text:
Hi,

Great, thanks for letting me know. Nothing changes on your side then, your order stays exactly as it is and keeps its place in the queue.

You'll get the tracking email automatically as soon as it leaves the warehouse, so there's nothing for you to do from here.

If anything else comes up, or you want the current ship date confirmed again, just reply here with your order number and I'll pull it up.

Thanks for sticking with us.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
